text:
tess: Quick RFC: add a guarded header `X-Assert-Owner` to let clients explicitly state intended routing/tenant for tricky SA flows. Goal: predictable routing + auditable overrides.
ram: Sounds similar to other header proposals but what's the differentiator?
tess: Two differences: 1) header is strict-guarded by require_admin_ack flag per-org, 2) we always log a compact signed assertion blob so downstream audit is tamper-evident.
nora: How would signed blob look? Example?
tess: Example: `X-Assert-Owner: tenant=acme;sig=base64(hmac(key, tenant|ts))` — gateway verifies HMAC using key-specific secret stored in auth service. If signature invalid -> 403.
ram: That prevents proxies from forging header. Nice. But key management complexity increases. Who issues the HMAC secret?
tess: Auth service generates an ephemeral assertion-secret per-key when admin enables header for that key. Secret rotation via normal key rotation flows. We store only hashed secret server-side.
billing-cam: For billing we need to be deterministic. If header used, resolved_owner -> header value, billing_account still comes from key unless org opts in. Add `owner_resolved` and `owner_assertion_used` to exports.
nora: Telemetry: metric labels `owner_source`= {claim, header_assertion, default} and `owner_assertion_verified` boolean. Also track `assertion_signature_failures`.	ram: Security question: what if an allowed key tries to assert a different tenant than it has rights to? We must enforce ACL: key-level allowed_owners list. Assertion only accepted if claimed owner in allowed_owners.
tess: Exactly. Flow: gateway extracts header -> verifies signature -> checks allowed_owners -> record audit event -> attach routing metadata.
audit-bot: Note: create audit event type `owner_assertion` with payload `{key_id, asserted_owner, decision, request_id}`. Retain 180 days.
billing-cam: Console UX: per-key toggle "Allow asserted owner" with a one-click admin confirmation and link to audit log. Show last 30 asserted-owner attempts.
nora: Rollout: start with assertion-audit-only mode (no routing) for 2 weeks to collect signal. Then gated canary (whitelisted orgs) with admin opt-in.	ram: Rate-limits: keep per-key hard limits, then coarse owner-tier shaping. Avoid exploding metric cardinality by bucketing owners into tiers in metrics.
tess: Edge-case: internal infra that mints ephemeral tokens for other tenants. Ensure token exchange propagates allowed_owners claim and assertion-secret when appropriate.
billing-cam: CSV export will add fields `owner_resolved`, `owner_assertion` (true/false), `billing_account_used`. Finance needs a 30-day migration window.
ram: Implementation tasks: gateway: parse header + verify HMAC, auth: manage assertion secrets + allowed_owners ACL, routing: use resolved owner for pool selection when enabled, quota: apply soft owner-level counters.
tess: Also add server-side validation errors with clear codes: `owner_assertion.invalid_sig`, `owner_assertion.not_allowed`, `owner_assertion.missing_claim`.
nora: SLO: auth path verification must remain <35ms p95 even with HMAC check. Add test harness.
audit-bot: Scheduled job: create audit index mapping and retention policy for `owner_assertion` events at 2026-04-07T08:00Z.
tess: Action items: @ram implement gateway verification + error codes, @nora add metrics + dashboard panels, @billing-cam add export fields + console toggle. I'll write the short design doc and SDK guidance.
ram: Ack. I'll open a PR with tests for invalid_sig and allowed_owners.
nora: I'll sketch Grafana panels: assertion_ratio, signature_fail_rate, owner_override_heatmap.
billing-cam: I'll prep billing schema changes and notify downstream teams.
tess: OK conservative by default. Keep assertion disabled unless admin flips toggle. Thanks.
